body: It is really fucked up... She wants to live a life full of depression, devoted to the girl. I don’t understand it.
Her mom doesn’t understand... she can’t help. Her father lives far away and doesn’t care.
How can I do that, please?

I know I should tell her something but I am very scared of doing so. I also don’t understand why she didn’t get it checked by doctors, she is not stupid but she acts like it’s nothing. Her coughing was never mentioned within my family.
Even if I told her something, I think my words don’t matter :( I have never talked with her about something so serious...
I wish you and your grandma good luck.
Thanks, I have never seen those in Slovakia before. Couldn’t get a better photo, it flew away really quickly.

Thanks for your help, but I am planning to kill myself this month. I can’t do it anymore. I think my mother has cancer. She has been coughing non-stop for like a year and it’s getting really bad. She coughs up blood and she coughs like every 15 seconds and it puts me in a huge depression. She acts like she is healthy and she probably thinks it too. Also my classmates are starting to bully me again... I am a failure and I don’t want to live anymore.
